method: Independently resolve all 36 annotation slots; partition known-positive minutes by :50 annotations; compare raw six-slot pressure distributions without fitting or threshold selection.
limitations: No model fitting, threshold changes, alternative target evaluation, or source reopening beyond the consumed six WaterHub months.
An earlier-only label identifies a label/representation timing mismatch, not proof that a physical anomaly was discarded or caused a model miss.
Range and standard deviation are descriptive raw-pressure statistics in native units; differences do not establish detectability or chemical faults.
Unknown labels remain unknown. Raw feature availability is independent from label knowledge. Audit flag counts may overlap.
Within-minute distributions require all six finite raw readings per channel and no structural ambiguity. Missing earlier pressure values can coexist with an available selected :50 feature.
Monthly duplicate masks reproduce the frozen complete-source availability exactly; valid member timestamps cannot cross their calendar month.
UWO and all other unused sources remain unopened. These post-test observations are not new validation evidence.

interpretation.narrow_timing_hypothesis: The OR target is positive while every :50 annotation is normal in only the reported earlier-only fraction. This is a real but infrequent minute-label mismatch; it does not support that mismatch as the general explanation for low positive-minute coverage.
interpretation.interval_scope: Intervals use the original minute target; a first-row or post-unknown positive interval is censored. Entirely earlier-only intervals distinguish complete short-interval omission from boundary-minute differences, without changing any frozen metric or model prediction.
interpretation.pressure_evidence: Raw within-minute variation is present in both annotated and known-normal minutes. Its range and standard deviation are lost from a last-value-only representation, but these descriptive distributions alone neither prove that this information is useful nor show that it caused a missed event.
interpretation.counterfactual_not_tested: No alternative aggregation, model, threshold, or annotation target was evaluated. Whether additional causal raw summaries help remains an untested development hypothesis.
